_meta.extracted_with: figma/extract-components.js via the Figma plugin channel
_meta.note: The design-system board and the v3 screens are still built from plain frames. Real component sets live on the 🧩 Components page. A slash namespaces a Figma sub-part (Tabs / Tab, Table / Row) — the canvas equivalent of a compound child in code, which is why it pairs with no prop. Interactive controls carry the canonical set default/hover/pressed/focus/disabled.

Button.description: Primary action control. variant/size/loading map 1:1 to ButtonProps; State models CSS interaction states and the native disabled attribute, which are not React props.

Badge.description: Status and segment tag. tone maps to BadgeTone; Dot maps to the dot prop. Wash fill + ink text, the audited pairing the tables use.

Card.description: Surface for a group of related facts. Quiet is the default for peer cards (hairline, no shadow); Raised earns a shadow and means "pay attention"; Selected carries the brand border.

Avatar.description: Player identity in tables and feeds. size maps to AvatarSize. Initials fallback; the image slot is an override, not a variant.

Input.description: Labelled text field. error and required map to props of the same name; State covers the CSS pseudo-classes plus the native readonly and disabled attributes; Content is placeholder vs value. Read-only keeps full text contrast — the value is still readable and selectable, unlike disabled.

Select.description: Native select in the same field shell as Input. error and required map to props of the same name; State covers the CSS pseudo-classes and the native disabled attribute; Content is placeholder vs chosen value. No Read-only: <select> has no readonly attribute.

Checkbox.description: Row select and rule toggles. indeterminate maps to the prop; Checked and State model the native checked and disabled attributes. Indeterminate wins over Checked, matching the CSS cascade.

Switch.description: Automation rules on and off. Checked and State model the native checked and disabled attributes; label is a text override. The thumb sits at the track edge via auto-layout alignment, not a hardcoded offset.

Tabs / Tab.description: One tab. Selected draws the 2px brand underline the CSS puts on aria-selected; Focus is the focus-visible outline. Roving arrow-key focus lives in the code, not here.

Tabs.description: Tab bar with its panel. Compose it from Tabs / Tab instances and switch their State — the code takes items[] and owns selection, so there is no variant axis here.

DropdownMenu / Item.description: One menu item. Highlighted is a single state on purpose — Radix sets data-highlighted for pointer hover and keyboard focus alike. Disabled keeps text/secondary because the item usually states why it is unavailable.

DropdownMenu.description: Actions on a thing. Compose from DropdownMenu / Item instances. side and align are Radix placement props, not design variants, so they are not modelled here.

Table / Header cell.description: Sortable column header. Sort maps to the aria-sort value the code sets; Numeric mirrors th--num, which right-aligns the label so a money column and its header share one edge.

Table / Row.description: One data row. Signed amounts take success/ink and danger/ink and sit right-aligned on tabular numerals.

Table.description: Transactions and tables grid. Compose from Table / Header cell and Table / Row instances. The code is compound — Table.Head, Table.Row, Table.Cell — and these sub-parts are the canvas equivalent.
